newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to announce nine-mth GNP on Nov 30.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to announce nine-mth GNP on Nov 30.

text.p: The Philippines is set to announce the nine-month gross national product (GNP) and gross domestic product (GDP) figures on Saturday, November 30, an official said on Thursday.
The announcement is scheduled at 9:30 a.m. (0130 GMT) at the office of the National Economic and Development Authority.
A recent Reuter poll showed analysts were expecting the GNP to grow by 7.16 percent in the first three quarters as compared with 5.6 percent growth in the same period last year.
